<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_TicketBooking"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/ticket-booking">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_BookingDetails" name="Booking details and payment details"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Ticket" name="Ticket"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Reminder" name="Pre-travel reminders and instructions"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="Customer ticket booking and travel" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Customer_Start" name="Begin ticket search">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Customer_Flow_1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Customer_Search" name="Search for a flight, train, or bus ticket">
      <bpmn:incoming>Customer_Flow_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Customer_Flow_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Customer_Select" name="Select route, date, and time">
      <bpmn:incoming>Customer_Flow_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Customer_Flow_3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Customer_ProvideDetails" name="Provide personal information and payment details">
      <bpmn:incoming>Customer_Flow_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Customer_Flow_4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Customer_SendBooking" name="Submit booking details" messageRef="Message_BookingDetails">
      <bpmn:incoming>Customer_Flow_4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Customer_Flow_5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Customer_ReceiveTicket" name="Receive ticket" messageRef="Message_Ticket">
      <bpmn:incoming>Customer_Flow_5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Customer_Flow_6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Customer_ReminderSplit" name="Are reminders sent?" default="Customer_Flow_8">
      <bpmn:incoming>Customer_Flow_6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Customer_Flow_7</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Customer_Flow_8</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Customer_ReceiveReminder" name="Receive reminders and check-in or boarding instructions" messageRef="Message_Reminder">
      <bpmn:incoming>Customer_Flow_7</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Customer_Flow_9</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Customer_ReminderMerge" name="Continue after reminder option">
      <bpmn:incoming>Customer_Flow_8</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Customer_Flow_9</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Customer_Flow_10</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Customer_CompleteJourney" name="Complete journey">
      <bpmn:incoming>Customer_Flow_10</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Customer_Flow_11</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Customer_PostTravelSplit" name="Are post-travel feedback or services applicable?" default="Customer_Flow_13">
      <bpmn:incoming>Customer_Flow_11</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Customer_Flow_12</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Customer_Flow_13</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Customer_PostTravel" name="Provide feedback or use post-travel services">
      <bpmn:incoming>Customer_Flow_12</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Customer_Flow_14</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Customer_PostTravelMerge" name="Continue after post-travel option">
      <bpmn:incoming>Customer_Flow_13</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Customer_Flow_14</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Customer_Flow_15</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="Customer_End" name="Customer process concludes">
      <bpmn:incoming>Customer_Flow_15</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Customer_Flow_1" sourceRef="Customer_Start" targetRef="Customer_Search"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Customer_Flow_2" sourceRef="Customer_Search" targetRef="Customer_Select"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Customer_Flow_3" sourceRef="Customer_Select" targetRef="Customer_ProvideDetails"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Customer_Flow_4" sourceRef="Customer_ProvideDetails" targetRef="Customer_SendBooking"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Customer_Flow_5" sourceRef="Customer_SendBooking" targetRef="Customer_ReceiveTicket"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Customer_Flow_6" sourceRef="Customer_ReceiveTicket" targetRef="Customer_ReminderSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Customer_Flow_7" name="Reminders are sent" sourceRef="Customer_ReminderSplit" targetRef="Customer_ReceiveReminder">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">reminderSent</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Customer_Flow_8" name="No reminders are sent" sourceRef="Customer_ReminderSplit" targetRef="Customer_ReminderMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Customer_Flow_9" sourceRef="Customer_ReceiveReminder" targetRef="Customer_ReminderMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Customer_Flow_10" sourceRef="Customer_ReminderMerge" targetRef="Customer_CompleteJourney"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Customer_Flow_11" sourceRef="Customer_CompleteJourney" targetRef="Customer_PostTravelSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Customer_Flow_12" name="Post-travel feedback or services" sourceRef="Customer_PostTravelSplit" targetRef="Customer_PostTravel">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">postTravelActivityApplies</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Customer_Flow_13" name="No post-travel activity" sourceRef="Customer_PostTravelSplit" targetRef="Customer_PostTravelMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Customer_Flow_14" sourceRef="Customer_PostTravel" targetRef="Customer_PostTravelMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Customer_Flow_15" sourceRef="Customer_PostTravelMerge" targetRef="Customer_End"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_TravelCompany" name="Travel company ticket processing" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Company_BookingReceived" name="Booking details received">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Company_Flow_1</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="Company_BookingMessageDefinition" messageRef="Message_BookingDetails"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Company_GenerateTicket" name="Generate ticket">
      <bpmn:incoming>Company_Flow_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Company_Flow_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Company_SendTicket" name="Send ticket to customer" messageRef="Message_Ticket">
      <bpmn:incoming>Company_Flow_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Company_Flow_3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:task id="Company_UpdateInventory" name="Update seat inventory">
      <bpmn:incoming>Company_Flow_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Company_Flow_4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Company_ReminderSplit" name="Send pre-travel reminders?" default="Company_Flow_6">
      <bpmn:incoming>Company_Flow_4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Company_Flow_5</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Company_Flow_6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Company_SendReminder" name="Send reminders and check-in or boarding instructions" messageRef="Message_Reminder">
      <bpmn:incoming>Company_Flow_5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Company_Flow_7</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="Company_EndAfterReminder" name="Company process concludes after reminders">
      <bpmn:incoming>Company_Flow_7</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="Company_EndWithoutReminder" name="Company process concludes without reminders">
      <bpmn:incoming>Company_Flow_6</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Company_Flow_1" sourceRef="Company_BookingReceived" targetRef="Company_GenerateTicket"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Company_Flow_2" sourceRef="Company_GenerateTicket" targetRef="Company_SendTicket"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Company_Flow_3" sourceRef="Company_SendTicket" targetRef="Company_UpdateInventory"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Company_Flow_4" sourceRef="Company_UpdateInventory" targetRef="Company_ReminderSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Company_Flow_5" name="Reminders are sent" sourceRef="Company_ReminderSplit" targetRef="Company_SendReminder">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">reminderSent</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Company_Flow_6" name="No reminders are sent" sourceRef="Company_ReminderSplit" targetRef="Company_EndWithoutReminder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Company_Flow_7" sourceRef="Company_SendReminder" targetRef="Company_EndAfterReminder"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_TicketBooking">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer" processRef="Process_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_TravelCompany" name="Travel company" processRef="Process_TravelCompany"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_BookingDetails" name="Booking details and payment details" sourceRef="Customer_SendBooking" targetRef="Company_BookingReceived" messageRef="Message_BookingDetails"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Ticket" name="Ticket" sourceRef="Company_SendTicket" targetRef="Customer_ReceiveTicket" messageRef="Message_Ticket"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Reminder" name="Pre-travel reminders and instructions" sourceRef="Company_SendReminder" targetRef="Customer_ReceiveReminder" messageRef="Message_Reminder"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
</bpmn:definitions>
